verdicts.reason: A keeps the original left-to-right order (date card, headphones, headline, RSVP, details) with a one-line headline and a clear CTA. Its flaws: the date card is too small to read 'NOV' or the time, the eyebrow is microscopic, and the body copy on the far right is illegibly small and crowds the edge. B has a strong two-line headline but crams the date card, headphones, RSVP button, body copy and eyebrow into a cluttered right-hand cluster. The 'LISTENING SESSION' eyebrow ends up at the bottom below the body copy, which breaks the reading order, and the body text sits jammed under the button at an unreadable size.
